note: Both sets suffer from significant duplication and some quote concatenation errors (e.g., merging unrelated sentence fragments). However, Set A is preferred because it maintains accurate numerical values for engineering constraints (e.g., '10 grams maximum'), whereas Set B introduces a value error ('< 10 g' instead of 'maximum 10 g') and includes vague claims with incomplete transition values ('Martensite', 'Austenite'). Set A's structured data (entity, attribute, value) is more reliable despite the noisy quotes.
